Whoa, it's really here!\nBut, what's happening to it? Is it drunk?
I wonder why it is in a place like this...\nAnyway, we should bring it back.
Adventurer, would you please?
No way! I'm not leaving this place!
Uh? What was that? Whose voice was that?
I-is that you, Caylass...?!
No, I don't think so. I guess it's just imitating\nthe figure that influences it the most.
Um, dear Scarlet Sakura...?\nWould you please go back with us?\nYou can drink as much as you want after that...
Why should I go back?\nThere's plenty of booze here ♪\nI'm not going back until I drain this place!
I guess it's not just the look...\nEven that attitude is somewhat similar to\nCaylass', don't you think so?
In that case, I think we need to do this\nby force...\nAdventurer, can we count on you?
It finally seems to behave itself...
The ghastly aura seems to have subsided too...\nAlright, let's take this back to Caylass!
Oh, it's you!
What brings you here?
Well, we were just told to check how things are\ngoing. Shouldn't you be heading home?
Yeah, I believe she's sobered up too.
Yeah, right.\nBut before that, I wanna try fighting you,\nadventurer. What do you say?
B-but why?!\nDon't tell me you're still drunk?
Nope. I'm very sober now.\nThat's why I wanna try fighting the adventurer\nwhile I'm sober like this.
Whaaat? Oh no~.\nNot again, this is gonna be troublesome...
Pleeeease!\nJust spare a little time for me and I promise\nI'll go back right away.
Argh, whatever, it always ends up like this!\nHey, c'mon ready up!
